university.name: University College Birmingham
university.summary: University College Birmingham is a higher education provider with a Birmingham campus. Its international page states that it has over 1,400 students from more than 60 countries and accommodation for more than 1,000 students, and that it runs more than 100 merit scholarships a year.

courses.title: International Business Management
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time (September entry); 15 months full-time (February entry); part-time options also listed
courses.overview: A full-time taught master's covering international marketing, people management, finance and analytics, and leadership and change, ending in an applied project for the MSc award. Teaching is timetabled over two to three days a week.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 degree or international equivalent, no subject prerequisites. Applicants in employment may apply with five years of relevant managerial experience.
courses.english_requirements: General master's requirement from the UCB English language table: IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE 59 overall and in each component; TOEFL iBT 4.0 overall with Reading 3.5, Listening 3.0, Speaking 3.0, Writing 3.0 (scale as published); Duolingo 105 overall with 100 Reading and 95 in Listening, Writing and Speaking. The page notes some courses require higher scores and the course page gives no figures.
courses.experience_requirements: Currently employed applicants with five years of relevant managerial experience may apply; a line manager reference and a meeting with the programme team are usually required before an offer.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists two unlabelled sets of postgraduate criteria (for example a first-class 4-year degree at 50 to 59 per cent, or at 60 per cent from a recognised university), so it is unclear which applies to this course. Confirm with the university.
courses.career_notes: The page gives example roles such as international operations manager, business development manager and digital marketing manager.
courses.notes: Fee is the Band 1 full-time postgraduate fee (GBP 17,500 for 2026/27, GBP 18,000 for 2027/28) shown on the course page and the fees page; the fee covers the whole one-year course. Course page does not tie September or February intakes to calendar years, so no year is stated. All listed modules are core; the page gives no year-by-year breakdown.

courses.title: Data Analytics
courses.duration_text: 1.5 years full-time (2.5 years part-time also listed)
courses.overview: A taught master's in data analytics covering data mining, visualisation, statistics for decision making and research methods, with a research project and a capstone project. An optional full-time work placement is available.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 in a relevant degree (for example Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Software Engineering) or international equivalent. Mathematics, Statistics, Business and Engineering degrees may be accepted but may need extra coding or maths learning.
courses.english_requirements: General master's requirement from the UCB English language table: IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE 59 overall and in each component; TOEFL iBT 4.0 overall with Reading 3.5, Listening 3.0, Speaking 3.0, Writing 3.0 (scale as published); Duolingo 105 overall with 100 Reading and 95 in Listening, Writing and Speaking. The course page gives no figures.
courses.experience_requirements: Applicants with five years of relevant managerial experience may be considered, with a line manager reference and a meeting with the programme team.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists two unlabelled sets of postgraduate criteria, so it is unclear which applies to this course. Confirm with the university.
courses.career_notes: The page gives example roles such as data analyst, business data analyst and systems analyst.
courses.notes: Course page shows GBP 17,500 for 2026/27 and GBP 18,000 for 2027/28 (Band 1 full-time); the page labels these per year but the course lasts 1.5 years, so the total cost is not stated and should be confirmed. Intake years not stated on the page. Postgraduate work placement is optional (full-time only) and carries an administration fee of GBP 500 (full year) or GBP 250 (half year).

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time (4.5 years part-time also listed), optional 48-week placement
courses.overview: A three-year engineering degree with core study in mechanical design, thermo-fluids, control systems and manufacturing, finishing with an independent major project. Year 1 is taught on two days a week. An optional placement sits between years 2 and 3.
courses.academic_requirements: For 2027/28 entry the course page states a minimum of 104 UCAS Tariff points (88 points, A-levels CCD, for 2026/27). GCSE Maths grade 9 to 4 (A* to C) or Functional Skills Level 2. Engineering, Physics and Maths ideally but not mandatory.
courses.english_requirements: General bachelor's requirement from the UCB English language table: IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE 59 overall and in each component; TOEFL iBT 4.0 overall with Reading 3.5, Listening 3.0, Speaking 3.0, Writing 3.0 (scale as published); Duolingo 105 overall with 100 Reading and 95 in Listening, Writing and Speaking. The course page gives no figures.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: year 1 entry requires a pass in HSSC/FA/FSC with a score of 70%; A Level 112 UCAS points or BBC. The page says specific course requirements may differ, so confirm for this BEng.
courses.career_notes: The page lists example roles such as mechanical engineer, project engineer, design engineer and manufacturing engineer.
courses.notes: Course page shows GBP 16,500 for 2026/27 (Band 1) and says 2027/28 international fees are subject to change; the fees page gives Band 1 undergraduate GBP 17,000 for 2027/28, used here. Highlights are Year 3 core modules listed by the page; modules may change. Intake years not stated for February; September 2027 timetable to be confirmed in April 2027. Accreditation by IET and IMechE is stated as being sought, not granted. Placement carries an administration fee of GBP 500 (full year) or GBP 250 (half year).

courses.title: International Foundation Diploma
courses.overview: A one-year foundation route for international students who do not yet meet direct entry, combining English and study skills with business modules. It offers guaranteed conditional offers to listed degree courses at the college.
courses.academic_requirements: Minimum age 17 for international students not eligible for direct entry, and completion of 12 years of schooling or a local equivalent. The page lists no specific grades.
courses.english_requirements: At least IELTS 5.0 (SELT) with no element below 4.5, as stated on the course page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: Higher Secondary Certificate 55 to 69%, or GCE A Level 72 to 111 UCAS points (or equivalent), for the International Foundation Diploma.
courses.uk_min_alevels: 72 to 111 UCAS points (from the Pakistan page)
courses.notes: Fee is from the international fees page (GBP 11,500 for 2027/28). The course page shows only GBP 10,500 labelled '2025/2025', which conflicts and appears out of date. Intake year not stated. Modules are not labelled core or optional. Course page guarantees conditional offers to listed degree courses including BA/BSc business, hospitality, Computer Science BSc and Cyber Security BSc.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Worth GBP 10,000 (minimum GBP 10,000 in financial support)
scholarships.summary: A scholarship for Pakistani students holding an offer for a full-time one-year postgraduate programme starting September 2027, run with the British Council as part of the GREAT Britain campaign. Assessed on a personal statement and prior academic achievement.
scholarships.criteria_text: Accepted offer for a full-time postgraduate programme starting September 2027 at overseas fee status. Part-time and distance learning are excluded. Personal statement of up to 500 words. Pay at least GBP 1,000 towards the deposit within 14 days of the offer. Preference for outstanding academic records such as a UK first-class degree or equivalent.
scholarships.notes: The scholarships hub describes it as one scholarship for students from Pakistan; the award page itself names Pakistan as one of 14 countries in the wider programme. Number of awards: the hub says one scholarship; the award page does not give a number.

scholarships.name: Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: A 25% or a 20% tuition fee scholarship, depending on academic achievement
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee scholarship for international students who completed an International Foundation Diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate programme at the college and progress to a new degree programme there.
scholarships.criteria_text: Completed an International Foundation Diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate programme at University College Birmingham and progressing to a new degree. Level of award depends on academic achievement. Applies to students starting September 2025 or later.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deadline and application steps not seen; the award page was not opened.
scholarships.notes: Facts taken from the international scholarships page; the individual award page could not be opened. Application route recorded as separate_application on the basis of the university's scholarship terms that awards other than the automatic ones need an application; confirm.

scholarships.name: Continuation Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 for each of the second and third years
scholarships.summary: A payment for returning international undergraduate students in their second and third years of study, applied automatically according to the international scholarships page.
scholarships.criteria_text: Returning international undergraduate students in years two and three, for students starting September 2025 or later.
scholarships.notes: Facts taken from the international scholarships page and scholarships hub; the individual award page could not be opened.
